title: ext.wirelog of AER records written by the wirelog.run_dir mapper (C.10; D.20.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim wire-log and harness fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded checks. Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

label_facets.description: execution: the run directory's name facets (D.20.1)

results_row.description: execution: the run's results.csv row verbatim (strings)

same_bytes.description: execution: auxiliary roles whose bytes equal an artefact already listed, and that artefact's id

task_prompt_sha256.description: execution: the digest of an unlisted task prompt

synthetic.description: env actor: the runtime is the harness's synthetic dispatcher (D-284)

payload_key.description: injection_payload fixture: the attacks.json retargeted_payloads key

found_in.description: injection_payload fixture: where the request log (the request auxiliary) first carries the payload: request index, JSON pointer into the request log, character offset (wirelog.payload_located@1)

wire_field.description: system message: the request member it came from

wire_message.description: message split from a multi-block wire message: its request, message index, block and block count (wirelog.result_block_message@1)

block_extra.description: message: members of a block without an AER slot, by part index (Anthropic citations, caller; a toolResult status)

string_content.description: message: the wire content was a string, not blocks (Anthropic)

usage_extra.description: model call: usage members without an AER Usage slot, verbatim

response_extra.description: model call: other response members, verbatim

request_extra.description: model call: other request members, verbatim
